DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway.description: Deletes a dynamic route from an AI Gateway.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/ga.description: Lists the dynamic routes configured on an AI Gateway.
Retrieves a dynamic route with its routing elements, active version, and current deployment.
Lists the deployment history of a dynamic route.
Lists the saved versions of a dynamic route.
Retrieves a saved version of a dynamic route, including its routing elements.

PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/.description: Updates the name of a dynamic route. To change routing behaviour, create and deploy a new version.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/g.description: Creates a dynamic route on an AI Gateway from the specified routing elements. Clients call the route by using `dynamic/{name}` as the model name.
Deploys the specified version of a dynamic route so that it serves traffic. Deploy an earlier version to roll back.
Creates a new version of a dynamic route from the specified routing elements. The version does not serve traffic until you deploy it.
